# Meet the team

Visionaries. Experts. Leaders as ambitious as our mission. Working with customers and communities to build the infrastructure for what's next in AI.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6863cc86499b79ce3ab28f8b/6a906713ea1b20d096f7e010_Chris%20Dolan.png)

### Chris Dolan

Chief Data Center Officer

Chris Dolan is Chief Data Center Officer at Crusoe, where he leads the development and scaling of large-scale, high-density AI infrastructure. With more than 25 years of experience across the full digital infrastructure lifecycle—from site development and capital-intensive construction to operational execution and platform growth—Chris has built and scaled digital infrastructure platforms serving the rapidly expanding demands of cloud and AI. He co-founded and served as CEO of 365 Main, a market-leading data center platform that was successfully acquired by Digital Realty Trust. At Crusoe, his combination of development expertise, operational leadership, and track record of building institutional-scale infrastructure platforms positions him at the forefront of the transformation of data centers into the AI factories of the future. Chris holds a Bachelor of Architecture from The Catholic University of America.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6863cc86499b79ce3ab28f8b/6a906713ea1b20d096f7e010_Chris%20Dolan.png)

### Jamey Seely

Chief Legal Officer

Jamey Seely is Chief Legal Officer at Crusoe, where she oversees the company's enterprise governance, corporate strategy, capital markets matters, and global legal operations. A seasoned executive with decades of experience spanning the technology, energy, and industrial sectors, Seely excels at navigating complex financing, M&A, and public company transitions—including leading major IPOs. She is an award winning global Chief Legal Officer including recognition by the Denver Business Journal as one of the Top 25 Most Powerful Women in Business. She holds a J.D. from Southern Methodist University and a Professional Certificate in Energy Innovation from Stanford University.

### Matt Field

Chief Real Estate Officer

Matt Field is Chief Real Estate Officer at Crusoe, where he leads the company’s site acquisition, development, and expansion strategy for high-performance data centers. He is responsible for scaling Crusoe’s physical footprint to support the next generation of AI compute infrastructure. With 40 years experience in real estate development, capital markets, and infrastructure deployment, he is instrumental in identifying and securing strategic locations that enable Crusoe to build efficient, scalable, sustainable, and energy-aligned data centers. Prior to joining Crusoe, Matt  was Co-CEO of TMG Partners, one of the San Francisco Bay Area’s largest developers, where he held senior leadership roles in real estate and project finance, driving complex infrastructure projects from concept to completion. He holds a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Colorado.

### Michael Gordon

Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer

Michael Gordon is Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer of Crusoe. Prior to Crusoe, he was the COO & CFO at MongoDB, where he helped grow revenue 50-fold from $40 million to $2 billion, scaled the business model to generate meaningful operating leverage and led the Company’s IPO. Before MongoDB, Michael was the COO & CFO at Yodle and before that was a Managing Director in the Telecom investment banking group at Merrill Lynch. Michael started his career in brand management at Procter & Gamble. He serves on the boards of UiPath and Tech:NYC and is a Board Member, Emeritus at Share Our Strength, one of the nation's leading anti-hunger organizations. Michael is a member of the Council on Foreign Relations and was a David Rockefeller Fellow with the Partnership for New York City. He holds an A.B. from Harvard College and an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School.

### Tara Green

Chief People Officer

Tara Green is Chief People Officer at Crusoe, where she leads the company’s organizational and workplace strategy, talent acquisition, culture development, and global human resources operations. ## Leadership

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6863cc86499b79ce3ab28f8b/6a906895fbdec744983a0d83_Alon%20Yariv%E2%80%A8.png)

### Alon Yariv

VP, Business Development; Country Manager, Israel

Alon Yariv is Vice President, Business Development and Country Manager, Israel for Crusoe. He leads Crusoe's business development team, where he manages large compute initiatives, and partnerships with model labs, building on Atero's KV cache technology to deliver faster, more efficient inference for Crusoe Cloud customers. He co-founded Atero in 2024 with Omer Landau, betting that GPU memory optimization would be the key to unlocking real inference performance at scale. Crusoe acquired Atero, drawn to Alon's team and their shared conviction that vertical integration, and an energy-first approach, would define the winners in AI infrastructure. Alon built his career in Israel's tech scene. He holds both a Bachelor of Science and a Master of Science from Tel Aviv University.

### Andrew Likens

VP, Business Development, Energy

Andrew Likens is Vice President of Energy Infrastructure & Development at Crusoe. His interest in energy took root in the summer of 2009, leasing prospective acreage for Petrohawk in Louisiana’s Haynesville Shale. He spent the next decade building land and commercial development expertise across North Dakota, Montana, and Oklahoma, working for leading exploration and production companies. Andrew joined Crusoe in 2019, bringing a landman's instinct for finding and securing the resources big infrastructure needs. Today he leads Crusoe's push into new power sources—including a 1.5 GW nuclear-powered data center campus with Blue Energy in Victoria, Texas. He's a Certified Professional Landman and holds degrees in Finance and Business Administration from the University of San Diego.

### Jamie McGrath

SVP, Data Center Operations

Jamie McGrath is Senior Vice President, Data Center Operations & Construction at Crusoe, where he oversees the deployment, management, and continuous operation of the company's high-density computing infrastructure. With extensive leadership experience in critical infrastructure and mission-critical facilities, Jamie is responsible for scaling Crusoe's digital footprint while maintaining peak operational efficiency. He co-founded 365 Main and served as its COO, eventually selling the company to Digital Realty in 2010. He then led a complex carve-out of a data center portfolio from Equinix, ran that business for four years, and sold the portfolio. Jamie went on to advise Crusoe for three years before joining the operating team to build the Data Infrastructure Group.
